props.heading: Academic Profile
props.body:
I am a student at Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS-II) in Saugus, Massachusetts.

My work focuses on research-informed software, clear technical writing, and systems that make learning and collaboration easier to understand.

This portfolio is designed as a living academic dossier: a place where mentors, teachers, collaborators, and future reviewers can evaluate direction, evidence, and growth without digging through scattered links.

props.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
props.description: Short answers for mentors, collaborators, teachers, and search visitors.

faqs.question: What is the purpose of this portfolio?
faqs.answer: It presents Aarti Sri Ravikumar's academic direction, research-informed software projects, writing, and collaboration pathways in one evidence-oriented website.

faqs.question: Where should a reviewer start?
faqs.answer: Start with the Research section for project evidence, then read Methodology for process, Blog for writing, and Journey for progress context.

faqs.question: How can someone collaborate?
faqs.answer: Use the Support Center and include the project idea, scope, expected timeline, and relevant academic or technical context.

faqs.question: Is this portfolio built for search and AI discovery?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes canonical metadata, structured data, sitemap generation, robots rules, llms.txt, share metadata, and content sections written for clear summarization.

props.heading: Open to thoughtful academic and technical collaboration.
props.description: Useful collaborations begin with a clear question, a realistic scope, and a shared standard for evidence.
